about_the_game:
About This Game

An alien ship has crash-landed on prehistoric Earth. Stranded and far from home, the survivors find themselves surrounded by primitive humans. The only way back to the stars? Ignite the spark of civilization.

Click To Civ is a minimalist idle clicker game where you collect ancient civilization badges and grow your hometown into a thriving hub of progress.

Gameplay Loops

Caves: Explore mysterious caves, strike monolith-like rocks, and uncover badges hidden within. Each smash carries a chance to reward you with fragments of long-lost knowledge.

Hometown: Place your collected badges in your settlement. The more you gather, the higher the badge level — and the more gold your village produces passively over time.

Progression Through Simplicity

Badges are the heart of your progress. Every badge you earn drives your hometown to grow faster, stronger, and richer.

Theme

From humble caves of stone to the dream of interstellar flight, guide humanity’s first steps into civilization. Your mission: help the survivors rebuild, advance, and one day launch a starship to return to their homeworld.

Key Features

• Addictive clicker-core gameplay, instantly easy to grasp

• A streamlined idle loop — smash rocks, collect badges, grow civilization

• Relaxing yet rewarding progression

• A mix of mystery and sci-fi woven into a simple Stone Age setting

No clutter, no unnecessary complexity — just pure progression. Can you spark civilization and lead humanity back to the stars?
